name: urizen

Real charts & technicals for any tokenized US stock, SEC fundamentals + filings + insider activity, Wall Street analyst consensus, financial news, the macro calendar (Fed/CPI/jobs), live prediction-market odds, and on-chain price — plus the fund's live strategies, book, execution tape, and one-token exposure via $URI.
